Get Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) data with the FARS API

Source: R/get_fars.R
get_fars.Rd

This function provides a convenient interface for accessing FARS data or data summaries using a range of criteria. The api parameter allows you to call one of the following functions to access DOT NHTSA’s Crash API:

  • get_fars_crash_list returns a list of fatal crashes that have occurred in multiple states in one or more years.

  • get_fars_crash_details returns a details of a fatal crash that has occurred in a state for a single year.

  • get_fars_crashes a list of fatal crashes by location that have occurred throughout U.S.

  • get_fars_summary provides a count of injury severity that have occurred throughout U.S. including count of fatalities and crashes.

  • get_fars_year provides one of 20 FARS data tables for a single year. Supports downloading to a CSV or JSON file.

Both get_fars_crash_list and get_fars_crashes limit the returned data to 5000 records so consider limiting the range of years requested if data exceeds that threshold.

This package also enables access to the FARS data available through the NHTSA data downloads server in a zip format. Set api to "zip" or use the get_fars_zip function to download this data.

Usage

get_fars(
  state,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  county = NULL,
  api = c("crashes", "cases", "state list", "summary count", "year dataset", "zip"),
  type = NULL,
  details = FALSE,
  geometry = FALSE,
  crs = NULL,
  cases = NULL,
  vehicles = NULL,
  format = "json",
  pr = FALSE,
  path = NULL,
  download = FALSE,
  labels = TRUE
)

get_fars_crashes(
  state,
  county,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  details = FALSE,
  geometry = FALSE,
  crs = NULL,
  labels = TRUE
)

get_fars_cases(
  state,
  cases,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  details = FALSE,
  geometry = FALSE,
  crs = NULL,
  labels = TRUE
)

get_fars_crash_list(
  state,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  vehicles = c(1, 50),
  labels = TRUE
)

get_fars_summary(state, year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024), labels = TRUE)

get_fars_year(
  state,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  type = "accident",
  format = "json",
  path = NULL,
  geometry = FALSE,
  crs = NULL,
  download = FALSE,
  labels = TRUE,
  call = caller_env()
)

Arguments

state

Required. State name, abbreviation, or FIPS number. get_fars_crash_list supports multiple states.

year

numeric vector. One or more years. For get_fars_crashes, get_fars_crash_list, get_fars_summary, and get_fars_year (and the corresponding api values), the minimum and maximum values are used as the start and end year, so year = 2015:2020 and year = c(2015, 2020) both request data from 2015 through 2020 (with a message if year has gaps). For get_fars_cases, year must be a single year or one year for each case in cases. For get_fars_zip, each year is downloaded separately. Most api options support the years from 2010 through 2024 and "zip" supports 1975 to 2024. Defaults to getOption("crashapi.year", 2024) so the default year can be set for all functions with options(crashapi.year = 2022).

county

County name or FIPS number. Required for get_fars_crashes.

api

character. API function to use. Supported values include "crashes", "cases", "state list", "summary count", "year dataset", and "zip". If api is not provided, it is "cases" if cases is provided, "state list" if vehicles is provided, "year dataset" if type is provided, "zip" if pr is TRUE, and "crashes" otherwise.

type

Name of the dataset or data file to download when using the "year dataset" api or get_fars_year. Supported values include "ACCIDENT", "CEVENT", "DAMAGE", "DISTRACT", "DRIMPAIR", "DRUGS", "FACTOR", "MANEUVER", "NMCRASH", "NMIMPAIR", "NMPRIOR", "PARKWORK", "PBTYPE", "PERSON", "SAFETYEQ", "VEHICLE", "VEVENT", "VINDECODE", "VINDERIVED", "VIOLATION", "VISION", and "VSOE". "TRAILERVINDERIVED" is supported for 2016 onwards, "NMDISTRACT" and "RACE" for 2019 onwards, and "CRASHRF", "DRIVERRF", "PERSONRF", "PVEHICLESF", "VEHICLESF", and "WEATHER" for 2020 onwards. Lowercase or mixed case values are permitted.

details

Type of detailed crash data to return (either "events" or "vehicles"). If TRUE for get_fars or get_fars_crashes, detailed case data (excluding event and vehicle data) is attached to the returned crash data. If NULL for get_fars_cases, events and vehicle data are excluded from the returned case data. returned by get_fars_cases. Optional for get_fars_crash_details. Default: NULL for get_fars_cases; FALSE for get_fars and get_fars_crashes.

geometry

If TRUE, return sf object. Optional for get_fars_crashes.

crs

Coordinate reference system to return for get_fars_crashes if geometry is TRUE.

cases

One or more FARS case numbers. Required if api is "cases" or using get_fars_cases. Multiple case numbers can be provided.

vehicles

numeric vector with the minimum and maximum number of vehicles, e.g. c(1, 2) for minimum of 1 vehicle and maximum of 2. Required for get_fars_crash_list.

format

Default "json". "csv" is supported when using the "year dataset" api. "csv" and "sas" are supported for the "zip" api ("json" is treated as "csv").

pr

logical. If TRUE, download zip file with FARS data for Puerto Rico. Puerto Rico data is available for 1978 and from 1980 onwards. Default: FALSE for get_fars_zip only.

path

File path used if download is TRUE.

download

logical. If TRUE and the api is "year dataset" or "zip", download the data to a file. Default FALSE.

labels

If TRUE (default), add a "label" attribute to each column with a variable label from fars_vars_labels. Labels are shown by View() in RStudio and Positron and used by packages such as gt and gtsummary.

call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.
